title: Find your kind of green.
lead: A little curiosity. A few favourites. A space that feels like you.
local: Your favourites and care checkmarks stay in this browser. All experiences are simulated.
finderIntro: Three small choices to find a plant that fits your space.
wishIntro: A little collection of plants you love.
compareIntro: Choose up to three plants and see what makes each one different.
careIntro: An example calendar for checking soil, not an automatic watering prescription.
studioIntro: Try a different room, wall colour and pot finish in the Live Demo.
trackIntro: Explore a simulated journey from basket to doorstep.
limit: Compare up to 3 plants. Remove one to add another.
savedFull: Your wishlist is full. Remove a plant to add another.
emptyBody: Use the heart or compare button on any catalog card.
profileNote: Sample profiles for this demo; confirm actual care needs for a real plant.
sizeQ: How much space do you have?
noMatches: No available plants with sample profiles right now.
calendarHint: Tap any date to mark a check complete. Only water if the soil and plant need it.
tipLight: Rotate the pot occasionally for even growth. Start with gentle light and adjust slowly.
tipWater: Feel the soil before watering. Let excess water drain and avoid standing water.
tipSpace: Leave room for leaves and keep the pot away from heaters and cold drafts.
potNote: Decorative pot overlays are visual styling only.
simulationNote: This is an interactive preview. No order is sent, no payment is taken, and no delivery is scheduled.
receivedBody: Your chosen green companions are on the list.
packedBody: Imagine a snug box, plenty of protection and a care card.
transitBody: Your imaginary parcel is travelling to its new home.
deliveredBody: A fresh green corner, ready to enjoy.
trackingEmpty: Confirm a basket first or start an example journey.
